Warm cotton-paper ground, graphite-black type and hairlines, oxidized herb green, bruise violet, and one decisive vermilion-orange used only for Approve. Right Review Tray shows 3 agent-found proposals with source/provenance labels, rationale, rights status, Reject and one vermilion Approve action. Strong professional density, editorial hierarchy, real labels, no generic bento cards, no chatbot, no glossy gradients, no fake metrics, no floral ornament, no vintage scrapbook nostalgia. Full-fidelity product design, refined typography, accessible contrast, subtle physical depth, production-ready visual hierarchy.
